experiment_2_cuhk03_zero_shot.role: Market-trained model transferred unchanged to CUHK03-NP

experiment_3_cuhk03_supervised.role: CUHK03-specific supervised multi-resolution training followed by frozen standardized benchmark

scientific_interpretation.domain_shift: Experiment 2 demonstrated a large Market-to-CUHK03 zero-shot drop.
scientific_interpretation.resolution_robustness: Efficient remained close to Full after CUHK03-specific training, although the primary Detected resolution gap widened relative to Experiment 2.
scientific_interpretation.supervised_adaptation: Experiment 3 substantially improved CUHK03 absolute retrieval accuracy but did not eliminate the gap.
